request_payload.title: Benefits of early intervention with olipudase alfa in symptomatic children with acid sphingomyelinase deficiency: A sibling case-comparison study.

mentions.sentence: Non-neurological manifestations of this disease are amenable to enzyme replacement therapy (ERT) with olipudase alfa in both adult and pediatric patients.
